description:
Complete wallet ownership verification using the XRPL AccountSet transaction you broadcast.

Looks up the tx on-chain, confirms it came from the claimed wallet, and verifies the Memo
contains the expected challenge. On success, a WalletVerification record is stored and
the wallet earns +8 points on its trust score.

Returns:
    verified (bool), wallet, method, tx_hash, message.

issuer_id.description: If you are verifying ownership for an NFT issuer registry entry, provide its ID to mark it verified.
issuer_id.title: Issuer ID (optional)

tx_hash.description: The XRPL transaction hash of the AccountSet tx you submitted with the challenge in a Memo.
tx_hash.title: Transaction Hash

wallet_address.description: The XRPL wallet address (r...) you are verifying.
wallet_address.title: XRPL Wallet Address

name: confirm_wallet_ownership
title: Confirm Wallet Ownership
